name: Almonte (Spain)
description: A blue hoist stripe bearing the crowned municipal arms of Almonte (a tree, a flag and a tower), the fly white with a red bend sinister from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Almonte; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Almonte arms — tree, flag and tower
bend sinister from the lower centre to the upper fly
